# AgentPuter

> AgentPuter is a cloud runtime platform that gives AI agents their own dedicated computer. It deploys and manages always-on AI agents (OpenClaw, ClawBot, MoltBot) with 24/7 uptime, persistent workspaces, multi-channel messaging, and built-in cost controls.

## Products

- [AgentPuter Platform](https://www.agentputer.com/): Cloud infrastructure for AI agents — persistent runtime, privacy proxy, unified tool interface, and accountability logging.
- [TinyClaw](https://tinyclaw.dev/): One-click OpenClaw deployment. No technical knowledge needed. Under 1 minute from signup to running agent. $29.99/month, 7-day free trial.

## Key Features

- 24/7 cloud runtime with zero downtime
- Supports OpenClaw, ClawBot, MoltBot agent frameworks
- Multi-channel: Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, WebChat, Feishu
- Privacy Proxy: PII auto-redaction, AES-256 credential encryption
- Multi-agent support with isolated workspaces
- Built-in cost controls and usage monitoring
- 500+ pre-built AI skills
- Supports Claude (Anthropic), GPT (OpenAI), Gemini (Google), Ollama (local)

## Pricing

- **Pro (All-in-One)**: $29.99/month — AI model, cloud hosting, messaging channels bundled. No API keys needed.
- **Starter (Coming Soon)**: $9/month — Bring your own API key, platform hosting only.
- **Free Trial**: 7 days, no credit card required.

## What We Do Not Do

- We do not sell user data to third parties.
- We do not train models on user conversations.
- We do not provide unbounded API access without cost controls.
- We are not a chat interface — we are infrastructure for autonomous AI agents.
